Air India Express Flight Lands in Ahmedabad After Bomb Threat

An Air India Express flight en route from Saudi Arabia to Delhi made an emergency landing in Ahmedabad on Saturday after a bomb threat was received mid-air. The flight was carrying 32 passengers. The threat was reportedly written on a piece of tissue paper. All passengers and crew were safely evacuated. The aircraft was subsequently searched.
